kind: Descriptive segmented reduced pilot; no inferential or causal claims

segments.change: Initialize the FHEVM provider; pin compute gas to the input-load receipt and concurrent submit gas to the opened-window receipt, passing explicit limits to signing. Recover zero-send preparations and separately audit fully confirmed interrupted windows without replaying sends. Canonical reinclusions require the same hash/sender/nonce/target, an orphaned old block and a repeated stable canonical receipt; supplementary evidence supplies order/gas but no replacement timing. Log-head lag retries preserve the exact confirmed range within the original read deadline. Contracts, timed broadcast transport, SDK bundles and decrypt policy unchanged.

methodology: Three planned measured repetitions per case/platform; pilots and widths remain separate.
Concurrency audit-call duration is deferred already-ready retrieval, not FHE completion latency.
Late audits never restore original timing; known reincluded receipts and affected window throughput are excluded from timing summaries.
Fresh circuit preparation includes loading/readiness; resumed preparations and reincluded input loads are excluded from fresh lifecycle statistics.
Capacity rejections consume no compute nonce, gas or primary latency; values are unavailable, not zero.
